Notes:
- The docs site is generated from the repository docs/ directory with Hugo.
- The React build under /apps/web-react/ is the application layer for the Guided Tour.
- The Svelte build under /apps/web-svelte/ is retained as a developer-facing parity surface.
- Generated frontend copies under docs/static/apps/ are build artifacts, not source of truth.
